answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the generated TypeScript types differ from the committed ones. The PR adds new bulk-update input fields (e.g. asset_tags_to_add, asset_url, search_pagination_input) to the API, but the generated types were not regenerated and committed. The failure is deterministic and will repeat on rerun until the developer runs yarn generate-types-from-api and commits the output.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
